description: This file defines a 'Bullet' class that manages list operations (ordered, unordered, indent, outdent) within a rich text editor, utilizing DOM manipulation and range handling.

classes.name: Bullet
classes.description: A class providing methods to manipulate list structures (ordered, unordered, indentation) in a rich text editor.

methods.name: insertOrderedList
methods.description: Toggle an ordered list (OL) around selected content.

methods.name: insertUnorderedList
methods.description: Toggle an unordered list (UL) around selected content.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Increase indentation level of selected paragraphs or list items.

methods.name: outdent
methods.description: Decrease indentation level of selected paragraphs or list items.

methods.name: toggleList
methods.description: Convert paragraphs to list items or change list types, or remove list formatting.

methods.name: wrapList
methods.description: Wrap a set of paragraphs into a list of specified type.

methods.name: releaseList
methods.description: Convert list items back to paragraphs, optionally escaping to the body.
